data.title: Ethereum Is Testing Blocks Over 3 Times Bigger. Could That Help ETH Catch Up With Solana?
data.description: Ethereum is quietly running tests that could reshape how much work its network can handle at once, but a bigger question looms: will any of it matter if the mainnet upgrade has no launch date and traders are already walking away?
